L27: ERRATA 2
L28: 
L29:   * E1 Android Self Repair card overrides rulebook on Serious Wounds designer
L30: 
L31: RULING
L32:     The Android's Self Repair ability does not heal Serious Wounds. The card description overrides the rulebook text on this point.
L33: 
L34: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L35:   * E2 Ammo cannot be removed from weapons; transfers with the weapon on trade community high-engagement
L36: 
L37: RULING
L38:     Characters cannot remove ammo from their weapons. When a weapon is traded to another character, the ammo stays with the weapon.
L39: 
L40: AUTHOR: Natai (Sean McLaughlin, comparing printed Wave 1 rulebook to current Awaken Realms PDF)SOURCE: 【5†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(17 replies, 73 thumbs)DATE: 2021-05-31
L41: 
L42: DESIGNER CLARIFICATIONS 45
L43:   * D1 Scout's auto-search trait is mandatory publisher
L44: 
L45: RULING
L46:     The Scout's trait that automatically searches grey rooms is obligatory. The Scout cannot choose to search normally instead.
L47: 
L48: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L49: 
L50:   * D2 Eggs in the Nest can be targeted during combat publisher
L51: 
L52: CONTEXT
L53:     Players were uncertain whether combat with an Intruder blocked targeting Eggs in the same room.
L54: RULING
L55:     You can attack Eggs in the Nest during combat with an Intruder. A noise roll must be made normally even though you are already in combat.
L56: 
L57: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L58: 
L59:   * D3 Android cannot heal Serious Wounds via ship actions publisher
L60: 
L61: RULING
L62:     The Android character cannot heal dressed Serious Wounds through any ship action (e.g., Hibernation Chamber, Medical Bay).
L63: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L64: 
L65:   * D4 Turret firing conditions and targeting rules publisher
L66: 
L67: CONTEXT
L68:     Players were unclear on when turrets fire and what they hit.
L69: 
L70: RULING
L71:     Turrets fire in two cases: (1) when something enters the room, and (2) during the Fire Damage phase. A Target:All turret deals 1 Light Wound to characters AND 1 Injury to intruders in the room. A Target:Intruders turret hits only intruders.
L72: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L73: 
L74:   * D5 Bandages can be used on other players publisher
L75: 
L76: RULING
L77:     The Bandages item can be used on other players, not only on yourself.
L78: 
L79: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L80: 
L81:   * D6 Flamethrower and Medic weapon cannot be reloaded during combat publisher
L82: RULING
L83:     The Flamethrower (and the Medic's weapon) cannot be reloaded during combat. Reloading them is treated as using a Chemicals item, which is not permitted in combat.
L84: 
L85: AUTHOR: Awaken Realms (publisher)SOURCE: 【6†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】DATE: 2020-03-09
L86: 
L87:   * D7 Claw Attack does not kill a character already at wound threshold designer
L88: CONTEXT
L89:     Players debated whether a Claw Attack's combined damage could simultaneously trigger death when the character is already near their wound limit.
L90: 
L91: RULING
L92:     If a character has 2 Serious Wounds (3 for the Convict) and 2 Light Wounds, and receives a Claw Attack (2 Light Wounds + Contamination), they survive. The killing blow must come from a separate source of damage.
L93: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L94: 
L95:   * D8 Fire Damage resolves from lowest room number, largest intruder first designer
L96: 
L97: RULING
L98:     In the Fire Damage step, resolve damage to intruders from the lowest-numbered room to the highest. Within the same room, resolve from largest to smallest intruder type.
L99: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L100: 
L101:   * D9 Intruder attacks in the Event Phase resolve in Player order designer
L102: 
L103: RULING
L104:     Each intruder attack in the Event Phase is resolved in Player order, not in Room order.
L105: 
L106: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L107:   * D10 Intruder fleeing into another fire room takes a second fire injury designer
L108: 
L109: RULING
L110:     During the Fire Damage step, if an intruder takes a fire injury and flees to a higher-numbered room that is also on fire (whose fire has not yet been resolved), that intruder takes another fire injury.
L111: 
L112: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L113:   * D11 Destroyed Nest still spawns eggs in Intruder Bag Development designer
L114: 
L115: RULING
L116:     A destroyed Nest can still spawn eggs during the Intruder Bag Development step. The Nest remains destroyed regardless.
L117: 
L118: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L119: 
L120:   * D12 Technical Corridors Event causes no noise roll if intruder is already present designer
L121: RULING
L122:     The Technical Corridors Event does not trigger noise rolls in a room that already has an intruder.
L123: 
L124: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L125: 
L126:   * D13 Intruder retreating through a closed door destroys the door designer
L127: RULING
L128:     If an intruder retreats through a closed door (including when forced by the fire extinguisher), the door is destroyed and the intruder stays in the room — identical to normal intruder movement rules.
L129: 
L130: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L131: 
L132:   * D14 Blank token returns to the Intruder bag every time it is drawn designer
L133: RULING
L134:     The blank token is returned to the Intruder bag whenever it is drawn for an encounter — not only when it is the last token remaining in the bag.
L135: 
L136: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L137: 
L138:   * D15 No "empty" actions are permitted designer
L139: RULING
L140:     Actions that accomplish nothing are not permitted: you cannot Trade if nothing ends up being traded, reload a fully-loaded weapon, or Rest without a Contamination card in hand.
L141: 
L142: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L143: 
L144:   * D16 Interruption can cancel triggered character reactions designer
L145: RULING
L146:     The Interruption action can be used to cancel triggered reactions such as "Nerves of Steel", "Don't Panic", and the Scout's "Motion Scanner".
L147: 
L148: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L149: 
L150:   * D17 Interruption can be played after a player has already passed designer
L151: 
L152: RULING
L153:     A player may play an Interruption action card even after they have already passed their turn that round.
L154: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L155: 
L156:   * D18 You cannot attack a larva that is on your character board designer
L157: 
L158: RULING
L159:     Once a larva is on your character board (after you have been infested), you cannot attack it.
L160: 
L161: AUTHOR: wpflug13 (Will, citing Adam Kwapiński)SOURCE: 【7†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(27 replies, 31 thumbs)DATE: 2018-11-28
L162:   * D19 Escape Pods containing a character cannot be locked designer
L163: 
L164: RULING
L165:     A room containing a character inside an Escape Pod cannot be locked.
L166: 
L167: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L168: 
L169:   * D20 Characters in an Escape Pod are not considered to be in the room designer
L170: 
L171: CONTEXT
L172:     Players were uncertain whether Escape Pod occupants counted as being in the room for purposes of Interruption and noise.
L173: RULING
L174:     Characters inside an Escape Pod that has not yet departed are not considered to be in the room — the Interruption action cannot be used by them. However, noise rolls must still be made during the Intruder Bag Development step as if they were in the room.
L175: 
L176: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L177: 
L178:   * D21 CEO can use "Just One More Thing" in Escape Pod after passing, with one exception designer
L179: RULING
L180:     The CEO may use "Just One More Thing" while inside an Escape Pod after having passed, in order to leave the pod — unless the CEO is the final player to pass that round.
L181: 
L182: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L183: 
L184:   * D22 Second Airlock Procedure in the same room cancels the first designer
L185: RULING
L186:     If an Airlock Token is already placed in a room, activating a second Airlock Procedure cancels the original one.
L187: 
L188: AUTHOR: Lord_StarfoX (Peter B., citing Awaken Realms)SOURCE: 【4†boardgamegeek.com†boardgamegeek.com】(47 replies, 50 thumbs)DATE: 2021-03-06
L189: 
L190:   * D23 Airlock vents Heavy Objects; Laika is immune designer
L191: 
L192: RULING
L193:     The Airlock Procedure retains all Heavy Objects in the room (they are not vented into space). Laika is also immune to the Airlock Procedure and remains in the room.

L84: zničení hnízda
L85: 
L86: Rád bych si ujasnil ničení hnízda. Pochopil jsem to nejprve tak, že musím pokaždé vejce vyndat z kokonu a pak ho zničit, tedy minimálně 5x akce místnosti za 2 karty + karty za zničení, což mi přišlo hardcore, když hned po zničení prvního se tam seběhli dospělec (za událost) a pak hned královna (za evoluci), oba mě myslím kousli a při ústupu drápli a bylo po mně. Byla to asi taky dost smůla.
L87:

L94: 【39†G4nd4lf】
L95: 【107†Image】
L96: 
L97: vejce nemusíš sbírat, ale můžeš do nĕj v hnízdě střílet, hodit tam granát (ten zničí dvě) nebo oheň ničí jedno za kolo… při střelbě do vejce tuším házíš na hluk. je to v pravidlech, jen je teď nemám po ruce
L98: edit: citace z pravidel u popisu místnosti - zničení vejce: Je-li postava v jakékoli místnosti, kde je alespoň 1 vejce, které žádná postava nenese, může se pokusit vejce zničit. Proveďte akci střelba nebo útok na blízko. Každý výsledek hodu bojovou kostkou krom znamená zničení právě 1 vejce (i výsledek ). V případě útoku na blízko nedostáváte žádnou kartu infekce a vaše postava neutrpí poranění, pokud útok mine.
L99: Do místnosti (opět jakékoli) s vejcem, které nenese žádná postava, můžete také hodit granát jako do místnosti s vetřelcem. Granát zničí 2 vejce, Molotovův koktejl 1. Na vejce nesená postavami útočit nelze. Zničené vejce vyřaďte ze hry. Po každém jednotlivém (i neúspěšném) útoku na vejce musíte provést hod na hluk.
L100: Pozn.: Nezapomínejte, že i vejce v kokonu na panelu vetřelců jsou v Hnízdě a vztahuje se na ně ničení vajec či poškození ohněm, pokud Hnízdo hoří.
L101: 
L102: 16.9.2021 20:04:46 | Upraveno autorem (【40†porovnej】)
L103: 
L104: 【41†ebm_plays】
L105: 【108†Image】
L106: Asi tu zase pre niektorých budem za trotla, ktorý príliš bazíruje na pravidlách, ale nedá mi doplniť výklad pre človeka, ktorý má pravdepodobne seriózny záujem dozvedieť sa, ako sa táto udalosť v hre má správne, t.j. podľa oficiálnych pravidiel, hrať. Všetci, ktorí si myslia, že v hre Nemesis (a asi aj v mnohých ďalších) platí akýsi súbor nepísaných pravidiel, ktoré sú tak jasné, jednoznačné a "selsky" logické, že ich nie je nutné do pravidiel ani napísať, tak tí nech ďalej radšej ani nečítajú.
L107: Hniezdo sa pokladá za zničené, keď sú všetky vajcia z neho (reprezentujú ich žetóny vajec umiestnené na paneli votrelcov) buď odnesené preč alebo zničené (Pravidlá, str. 25 - Hnízdo/Nest). "Odnesené preč" znamená vytiahnuté (vyjmuté) z kokonu. Následne po vytiahnutí môže byť toto vajce okamžite upustené na zem, postava ho nemusí odniesť do inej miestnosti alebo držať u seba (viď FAQ v2.1, str. 4 - Rooms, q.#9).
L108: Ak chceš takýmto spôsobom odstrániť všetkých 5 vajec z panelu votrelcov, ktoré tam sú po setupe hry, je naozaj nevyhnutné vykonať akciu Vyjmutí vejce z kokónu 5x (zakaždým s nákladmi=2) a po každej akcii hádzať na hluk. Je prakticky nemožné vyhnúť sa pritom stretu, našťastie, druhá možnosť odstránenia vajec je ich priame zničenie. To je popísané v Pravidlách, tiež na strane 25 v odstavci "Zničení vejce" tak ako ich tu citoval 【39†@G4nd4lf】 .
L109: Niekto by po ich prečítaní mohol nadobudnúť dojem, že pri použití akcie strelby môžeš vždy zničiť maximálne jedno vajce (Bože, odpusť mi, ak som jediný, čo má tento dojem). Pravda je ale taká, že strelba na rozdiel od útoku na blízko môže priniesť viac zranení a tým pádom je možné zničiť viac vajec naraz. Teoreticky je možné jednou akciou strelby zničiť aj celé hniezdo. Príklad: hrám za vojaka, vo svojej útočnej výbojnici mám aspoň 4 náboje a na streľbu na vajcia použijem akciu "Plná dávka".
L110: Už týmto mám zaručené 2 zásahy, ale ak sa mi navyše podarí hodiť na bojovej kocke dva zásahy, spolu s bonusom, ktorý mi prináša útočná výbojnica, dávam celkove 5 zásahov, čo znamená zničenie 5 vajec naraz.
L111: Samozrejme, po akomkoľvek pokuse zničiť vajcia, sa hádže na hluk.
L112: Okrem toho, je dôležité po odstránení posledného vajca z panelu votrelcov označiť kockou zranenia hniezdo za zničené. Môže sa totiž stať, že počas nasledujúcich kôl sa v hniezde opäť objaví nové vajce v kokóne. Už to ale nemá vplyv na splnenie úlohy "zničenie hniezda".
L113: Posledná vec, ktorá sa tu už vysvetlovala, je fakt, že na vajcia môžem zaútočiť aj keď som v boji, t.j. v hniezde by sa nachádzal aj nejaký iný votrelec).
L114: Tak, a teraz do mňa šite.

L131: 【39†@G4nd4lf】 A použil by si streľbu a dobrovolne by si zbavil jednej munície, keď s použitím útoku na blízko dosiahneš s rovnakou pravdepodobnosťou jeden zásah a náboje ti zostanú? Občas treba zájsť aj na zahraničné fóra.
